selector_policy: Bind named source keys to concrete captured relative-file#JSON-pointer selectors; no guessed paths, globs or whole cache exclusions. Uncapturable keys require declared limitations, not fake selectors.

web.source: apps/fractal-web #6278 88adf9cfc9; integration ff956ae72b; main d7aa0be1db; owner inventory message/e53fcf79424227e0
limitations: Pairing id is not stored locally; use authoritative fixture-store record.
storageState does not by itself include sessionStorage; retain a separate actual read-only export when relevant.
Identity DB must be read without upgrade in a readonly transaction; never getOrCreate.
Live native ask UI persists no read/seen state per AlertsTab.tsx:67-88 and AgentAlerts.tsx:64-75; legacy persisted read paths still remain observable, not excluded.

Expected churn source message/e5ef7faed9606e1e supersedes earlier window-key guess. wf.window-id and wf.clear@1 are NOT churn. Migration keys require actual first-load migration provenance; user-action writes are not blanket-allowed. Expand gateway/deployment descriptors to actual observed concrete selectors only.
Keychain and SecureStore are not readable from an ordinary copied app container; retain an explicit actual capture limitation, never fabricate their contents.
iOS local public-key API is JS-only, not reachable by XCUITest; primary identity proof is daemon-side.
Pairing id is not persisted locally; use authoritative fixture-store record.
Fabric identity() can create a key; never use it as a read-only observer.
st3.fabric.profile suffixes are actual generated member values; expand only from observed keys, never literal placeholder selectors.

tui.source: TUI a4107410; SDK 62adcce8; owner e3-tui-inventory; safe helper export owned by TUI
tui.raw_omit: Exact actual private profile relative path; never read it in Python. Use TUI helper safe export with pkcs8 and credential sentinels plus SHA-256.
limitations: Capture the whole isolated config, state and cache roots, not only the profile.
No packet-side private-key parsing. Use Profile::load public identity helper and sanitized export; never devices complete.
Pairing and enrollment IDs come only from authoritative fixture-store records.
Transient in-memory updates_read, acted, pending_answers and closed are a declared limitation, not a blanket claim of no local state.
Cache, drafts, glasses and preferences are diffed and scanned as named expected churn; concrete filenames come from actual capture, never guessed hashes.
